dataset_end_date_definition: Latest FILING_DATE in the downloaded Form D submissions. Rounds with no later Form D filing are censored on this date.
event_definition: Followed by another Form D filing. Many follow-on raises (SAFEs, convertible notes, rounds without a Form D) and shutdowns are invisible, so these rates are lower bounds on fundraising.
km_median_note: A long Kaplan–Meier median mostly means most rounds are never followed by another Form D filing. It does not mean the typical gap between filings is 5–7 years.
conditional_median_months_label: among rounds that were followed by another filing
probability_another_filing_by_month_labe: Kaplan–Meier probability that the round has been followed by another Form D filing by that month. Keys are months 1 through 36.
